info.title: Anakin
info.description: Anakin turns websites into clean, structured data. Scrape pages, search the web, crawl sites, run deep research, use ready made actions on hundreds of popular sites, monitor pages for changes, compare AI engine answers and run AI browser tasks.

post.description: Starts fetching one web page as markdown and HTML, with optional AI extraction. Use Get scrape result with the returned job ID to get the content.

url.description: The page to fetch, starting with http or https.

useBrowser.description: Whether to render the page in a browser. Use it for pages that need JavaScript; it is slower and costs more.

generateJson.description: Whether to also extract structured data from the page with AI.

outputSchema.description: A JSON schema of the fields to extract. Setting it turns on JSON extraction.

formats.description: The outputs to produce: markdown, html, cleanedHtml, links, images or summary. By default markdown, HTML and cleaned HTML.

country.description: The two letter country code to fetch from, for example us or de.

forceFresh.description: Whether to fetch the page again instead of using the 24 hour cache.

sessionId.description: The ID of a saved browser session, for pages behind a sign in.

jobId.description: The job ID. Pass it to the matching get result action.
jobId.title: Job ID

status.description: The job status, pending when the job is queued.
status.title: Status

post.description: Creates a monitor that checks a page, a whole site or a Wire action on a schedule and records changes. Every check costs credits.

aiMode.description: Whether AI should ignore trivial changes and summarize real ones. It adds 1 credit per check.
